image_description: A full-body side view of an American Bison standing on a dirt path with grass and a tree trunk in the background. The bison has a massive, shaggy dark brown forequarter with a prominent shoulder hump, transitioning to smoother, lighter brown fur on the hindquarters. It has short curved horns, a beard, and sturdy legs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible, showing a broad profile and short, upward-curving horns consistent with the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct fringe of long, dark hair hangs from the chin and throat area.
The eye is visible and appears dark/black, matching the description.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and partially obscured by the thick mane/fur on the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits the characteristic heavy build and height at the shoulders typical of a bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There is a clear textural and color contrast between the shaggy, dark forequarters/hump and the rest of the body.
The rear half of the body has significantly shorter, smoother hair compared to the front.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are proportionally small relative to the massive bulk of the head and body.
Legs appear thick and sturdy. While ground contact obscures fine detail, the visible lower legs and feet structure are consistent with cloven hooves.
The tail is visible hanging down, ending in a darker, bushy switch/tuft.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification and rule out hybrid or generic bovid errors.
To verify the structural integrity of the four legs and their connection to the massive torso, checking for fusion or missing limbs.
To check for 'melting' artifacts where the shaggy fur meets the background, a common AI failure mode.
To assess texture consistency in the fur and detect any subtle noise or pattern repetition.

focus_areas: Fur texture transition between forequarters and hindquarters
Horn symmetry and attachment to skull
Edge sharpness of the shaggy mane against the background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition zone between the shaggy front fur and the smoother rear fur; AI often blurs this boundary unnaturally. Verify that all four legs are present and structurally sound, as the stance might hide a missing leg. Check if the horns emerge logically from the skull without floating or asymmetrical warping.
